--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+const BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/promptbook-logo';
+
+async function checkLogoImages(page, minimumCount) {
+    const LOGOS = page.locator('img[src*="promptbook-logo-3d"]');
+    assert.ok((await LOGOS.count()) >= minimumCount, 'Expected shared 3D logo instances');
+    for (const LOGO of await LOGOS.all()) {
+        if (!(await LOGO.isVisible())) continue;
+        await LOGO.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await LOGO.evaluate((image) => image.decode());
+        const DIMENSIONS = await LOGO.evaluate((image) => ({
+            naturalWidth: image.naturalWidth,
+            width: image.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+            height: image.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+            filter: getComputedStyle(image).filter,
+        }));
+        assert.ok(DIMENSIONS.naturalWidth > 0, 'Logo must load');
+        assert.ok(Math.abs(DIMENSIONS.width - DIMENSIONS.height) < 1, 'Logo must remain square');
+        assert.ok(!DIMENSIONS.filter.includes('brightness(0)'), '3D shading must be preserved');
+    }
+}
+
+(async () => {
+    const BROWSER = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 } });
+        await PAGE.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        const ERRORS = [];
+        PAGE.on('pageerror', (error) => {
+            const DETAIL = { url: PAGE.url(), message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
+            ERRORS.push(DETAIL);
+            console.error('Page error:', DETAIL);
+        });
+        for (const ROUTE of ['/cs', '/en', '/branding', '/dekujeme']) {
+            const RESPONSE = await PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}${ROUTE}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+            assert.ok(RESPONSE.ok(), `${ROUTE} must load`);
+            await PAGE.locator('h1').waitFor();
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, ROUTE === '/branding' ? 4 : ROUTE === '/dekujeme' ? 2 : 3);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} desktop overflow`);
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                const DOWNLOAD_PROMISE = PAGE.waitForEvent('download');
+                await PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).click();
+                const DOWNLOAD = await DOWNLOAD_PROMISE;
+                assert.equal(DOWNLOAD.suggestedFilename(), 'promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png');
+                await DOWNLOAD.saveAs(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/downloaded-logo.png`);
+                const COLLECTION = PAGE.locator('section').filter({ has: PAGE.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pick the logo that fits the background.' }) });
+                assert.equal(await COLLECTION.locator('article').count(), 4);
+                for (const LINK of await COLLECTION.locator('a[download]').all()) {
+                    const ASSET_RESPONSE = await PAGE.request.get(new URL(await LINK.getAttribute('href'), BASE_URL).href);
+                    assert.ok(ASSET_RESPONSE.ok(), 'Every brand-kit download must exist');
+                }
+                await COLLECTION.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-downloads.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/footer-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, 2);
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} mobile overflow`);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-mobile.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                await PAGE.getByAltText('Promptbook logo in 3D', { exact: true }).screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-mobile-preview.png` });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('main > section').first().screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/homepage-mobile-hero.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            console.log(`${ROUTE}: desktop/mobile logos, layout and page checked`);
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        }
+        assert.deepEqual(ERRORS, [], 'Pages must have no runtime errors');
+        await PAGE.close();
+
+        const STATIC_PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ javaScriptEnabled: false, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
+        await STATIC_PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}/branding`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        assert.equal(await STATIC_PAGE.locator('img[alt="Promptbook logo in 3D"]').count(), 1);
+        assert.ok(await STATIC_PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).isVisible());
+        console.log('Brand-kit logo and download are server-rendered without JavaScript');
+    } finally {
+        await BROWSER.close();
+    }
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/components/promptbook-logo.tsx b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89408328e3be1e5877b76bbb01a84db3ec7995ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS } from '@/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+interface PromptbookLogoProps {
+    size?: number;
+    alt?: string;
+    className?: string;
+    isPriority?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The shared 3D mark. Use an empty alternative when adjacent text already names the brand.
+ * Next image optimization is disabled here, so choose a local render at twice the display size.
+ */
+export function PromptbookLogo({ size = 32, alt = 'Promptbook', className, isPriority = false }: PromptbookLogoProps) {
+    const LOGO_SOURCE =
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.find(({ width }) => width >= size * 2) ??
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS[PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.length - 1];
+
+    return (
+        <Image
+            src={LOGO_SOURCE.src}
+            alt={alt}
+            width={size}
+            height={size}
+            priority={isPriority}
+            className={cn('shrink-0 object-contain', className)}
+        />
+    );
+}
diff --git a/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets.ts b/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b53f41ebf7bea1d0f4a40b84e87c6e992adf4bd1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+/** Transparent download and web-sized renders of the same 3D artwork. */
+export const PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_DOWNLOAD_PATH = '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+
+export const PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS = [
+    { width: 128, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-128.webp' },
+    { width: 256, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-256.webp' },
+    { width: 512, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-512.webp' },
+    { width: 1024, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.webp' },
+] as const;

+# Promptbook 3D logo
+
+This is a static 3D render of `promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-1024.png`, generated
+with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-21. It keeps the three-part PB composition
+and adds blue surfaces, shallow extrusion, bevels and studio lighting. It is a raster
+brand asset, not an editable 3D model.
+
+`promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png` is the transparent, 1024 × 1024 download.
+The 128, 256, 512 and 1024-pixel WebP files are web previews of that same image.
+The shared `PromptbookLogo` component selects a preview at twice the requested display
+size, capped at 1024 pixels, because this site's Next.js image optimization is disabled.
+Small navigation logos therefore load the 128-pixel asset, not the full PNG.
+
+The PNG was resized from the generated image with Sharp, preserving alpha. The WebP
+exports use quality 88 and alpha quality 100. Keep them in step after any artwork change:
+
+```sh
+node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+
+const SOURCE_PATH = 'public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+for (const SIZE of [128, 256, 512, 1024]) {
+    await sharp(SOURCE_PATH)
+        .resize(SIZE, SIZE)
+        .webp({ quality: 88, alphaQuality: 100 })
+        .toFile(`public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-${SIZE}.webp`);
+}
+NODE
+```
+
+The `/branding` page previews the render and offers the PNG next to the existing flat
+variants. The flat files remain suitable for print, small favicons and high-contrast
+uses. Do not apply monochrome CSS filters to the 3D image: they remove its shading.
+
+## Generation prompt
+
+The existing blue transparent PNG was supplied as the edit target.
+
+```text
+Use case: style-transfer.
+Asset type: official Promptbook 3D logo render for a website header, footer and large brand-kit preview, square transparent PNG.
+Input image: the supplied Promptbook logo is the edit target and exact silhouette reference.
+Primary request: convert this precise flat blue mark into a beautifully lit three-dimensional solid with shallow visible extrusion and refined bevels. Preserve the original three separate shapes and their exact positions, proportions, camera angle and negative spaces: the floating triangle above, the P-shaped left face, and the large right face with its open B-shaped cutout. Preserve the recognizable PB cube/book composition. The front silhouette must match the reference; add depth behind it, not a redesigned cube.
+Style/materials: premium product rendering of deep royal-blue satin anodized metal or enamel, fine rounded edge bevels, smooth broad faces, convincing darker blue side walls and cool pale-blue edge reflections. No gritty texture. Keep the blue rich, close to the reference, with enough bright edge light to read on both white and very dark backgrounds.
+Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left, delicate cool rim light; restrained ambient occlusion only on the object. No floor, no cast shadow outside the object.
+Composition: one centered logo, fills about 88 percent of the square canvas, whole object visible with clear margins. The triangle and both letter faces must remain distinct and separated exactly as in the reference. Transparent background with actual alpha, including all gaps and cutouts.
+Constraints: change only depth, surface and lighting. Do not add letters, text, words, other shapes, a pedestal, an enclosing cube, a background, a gradient backdrop, glow, blur, watermark or checkerboard pixels. Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background.
+```

diff --git a/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b9854103095be2069a7cc2f44fdfb7ba04701bc8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+const BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/promptbook-logo';
+
+async function checkLogoImages(page, minimumCount) {
+    const LOGOS = page.locator('img[src*="promptbook-logo-3d"]');
+    assert.ok((await LOGOS.count()) >= minimumCount, 'Expected shared 3D logo instances');
+    for (const LOGO of await LOGOS.all()) {
+        if (!(await LOGO.isVisible())) continue;
+        await LOGO.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await LOGO.evaluate((image) => image.decode());
+        const DIMENSIONS = await LOGO.evaluate((image) => ({
+            naturalWidth: image.naturalWidth,
+            width: image.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+            height: image.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+            filter: getComputedStyle(image).filter,
+        }));
+        assert.ok(DIMENSIONS.naturalWidth > 0, 'Logo must load');
+        assert.ok(Math.abs(DIMENSIONS.width - DIMENSIONS.height) < 1, 'Logo must remain square');
+        assert.ok(!DIMENSIONS.filter.includes('brightness(0)'), '3D shading must be preserved');
+    }
+}
+
+(async () => {
+    const BROWSER = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 } });
+        await PAGE.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        const ERRORS = [];
+        PAGE.on('pageerror', (error) => {
+            const DETAIL = { url: PAGE.url(), message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
+            ERRORS.push(DETAIL);
+            console.error('Page error:', DETAIL);
+        });
+        for (const ROUTE of ['/cs', '/en', '/branding', '/dekujeme']) {
+            const RESPONSE = await PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}${ROUTE}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+            assert.ok(RESPONSE.ok(), `${ROUTE} must load`);
+            await PAGE.locator('h1').waitFor();
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, ROUTE === '/branding' ? 4 : ROUTE === '/dekujeme' ? 2 : 3);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} desktop overflow`);
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                const DOWNLOAD_PROMISE = PAGE.waitForEvent('download');
+                await PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).click();
+                const DOWNLOAD = await DOWNLOAD_PROMISE;
+                assert.equal(DOWNLOAD.suggestedFilename(), 'promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png');
+                await DOWNLOAD.saveAs(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/downloaded-logo.png`);
+                const COLLECTION = PAGE.locator('section').filter({ has: PAGE.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pick the logo that fits the background.' }) });
+                assert.equal(await COLLECTION.locator('article').count(), 4);
+                for (const LINK of await COLLECTION.locator('a[download]').all()) {
+                    const ASSET_RESPONSE = await PAGE.request.get(new URL(await LINK.getAttribute('href'), BASE_URL).href);
+                    assert.ok(ASSET_RESPONSE.ok(), 'Every brand-kit download must exist');
+                }
+                await COLLECTION.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-downloads.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/footer-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, 2);
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} mobile overflow`);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-mobile.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                await PAGE.getByAltText('Promptbook logo in 3D', { exact: true }).screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-mobile-preview.png` });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('main > section').first().screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/homepage-mobile-hero.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            console.log(`${ROUTE}: desktop/mobile logos, layout and page checked`);
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        }
+        assert.deepEqual(ERRORS, [], 'Pages must have no runtime errors');
+        await PAGE.close();
+
+        const STATIC_PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ javaScriptEnabled: false, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
+        await STATIC_PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}/branding`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        assert.equal(await STATIC_PAGE.locator('img[alt="Promptbook logo in 3D"]').count(), 1);
+        assert.ok(await STATIC_PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).isVisible());
+        console.log('Brand-kit logo and download are server-rendered without JavaScript');
+    } finally {
+        await BROWSER.close();
+    }
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

+- Promptbook's shared headers, footers, homepage chat preview, and participant-room header use the static 3D
+  mark through `components/promptbook-logo.tsx`. Its web-sized transparent renders and downloadable 1024-pixel
+  PNG are named in `lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets.ts`; `/branding` previews it alongside the flat variants.
+  `public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md` records its source and generation prompt. Flat artwork remains available
+  for print, favicons, and high-contrast uses; custom page identities keep their own marks.
 - `/pro-mesta`, `/pro-firmy`, `/for-agro`, `/for-industry`, `/ai-supervize`,
   `/hackathon-factory`, and `/pavol` are specialized landing pages. `/pavol`
   redirects to `/cs/pavol` or `/en/pavol`; the localized pages are Pavol Hejny's

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89408328e3be1e5877b76bbb01a84db3ec7995ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS } from '@/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+interface PromptbookLogoProps {
+    size?: number;
+    alt?: string;
+    className?: string;
+    isPriority?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The shared 3D mark. Use an empty alternative when adjacent text already names the brand.
+ * Next image optimization is disabled here, so choose a local render at twice the display size.
+ */
+export function PromptbookLogo({ size = 32, alt = 'Promptbook', className, isPriority = false }: PromptbookLogoProps) {
+    const LOGO_SOURCE =
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.find(({ width }) => width >= size * 2) ??
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS[PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.length - 1];
+
+    return (
+        <Image
+            src={LOGO_SOURCE.src}
+            alt={alt}
+            width={size}
+            height={size}
+            priority={isPriority}
+            className={cn('shrink-0 object-contain', className)}
+        />
+    );
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+# Promptbook 3D logo
+
+This is a static 3D render of `promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-1024.png`, generated
+with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-21. It keeps the three-part PB composition
+and adds blue surfaces, shallow extrusion, bevels and studio lighting. It is a raster
+brand asset, not an editable 3D model.
+
+`promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png` is the transparent, 1024 × 1024 download.
+The 128, 256, 512 and 1024-pixel WebP files are web previews of that same image.
+The shared `PromptbookLogo` component selects a preview at twice the requested display
+size, capped at 1024 pixels, because this site's Next.js image optimization is disabled.
+Small navigation logos therefore load the 128-pixel asset, not the full PNG.
+
+The PNG was resized from the generated image with Sharp, preserving alpha. The WebP
+exports use quality 88 and alpha quality 100. Keep them in step after any artwork change:
+
+```sh
+node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+
+const SOURCE_PATH = 'public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+for (const SIZE of [128, 256, 512, 1024]) {
+    await sharp(SOURCE_PATH)
+        .resize(SIZE, SIZE)
+        .webp({ quality: 88, alphaQuality: 100 })
+        .toFile(`public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-${SIZE}.webp`);
+}
+NODE
+```
+
+The `/branding` page previews the render and offers the PNG next to the existing flat
+variants. The flat files remain suitable for print, small favicons and high-contrast
+uses. Do not apply monochrome CSS filters to the 3D image: they remove its shading.
+
+## Generation prompt
+
+The existing blue transparent PNG was supplied as the edit target.
+
+```text
+Use case: style-transfer.
+Asset type: official Promptbook 3D logo render for a website header, footer and large brand-kit preview, square transparent PNG.
+Input image: the supplied Promptbook logo is the edit target and exact silhouette reference.
+Primary request: convert this precise flat blue mark into a beautifully lit three-dimensional solid with shallow visible extrusion and refined bevels. Preserve the original three separate shapes and their exact positions, proportions, camera angle and negative spaces: the floating triangle above, the P-shaped left face, and the large right face with its open B-shaped cutout. Preserve the recognizable PB cube/book composition. The front silhouette must match the reference; add depth behind it, not a redesigned cube.
+Style/materials: premium product rendering of deep royal-blue satin anodized metal or enamel, fine rounded edge bevels, smooth broad faces, convincing darker blue side walls and cool pale-blue edge reflections. No gritty texture. Keep the blue rich, close to the reference, with enough bright edge light to read on both white and very dark backgrounds.
+Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left, delicate cool rim light; restrained ambient occlusion only on the object. No floor, no cast shadow outside the object.
+Composition: one centered logo, fills about 88 percent of the square canvas, whole object visible with clear margins. The triangle and both letter faces must remain distinct and separated exactly as in the reference. Transparent background with actual alpha, including all gaps and cutouts.
+Constraints: change only depth, surface and lighting. Do not add letters, text, words, other shapes, a pedestal, an enclosing cube, a background, a gradient backdrop, glow, blur, watermark or checkerboard pixels. Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background.
+```

codex
The logo and downloads look correct on desktop and mobile, and all five page smoke tests passed. The brand-kit logo and download also work without JavaScript. Browser checks surfaced a cancellation warning from the existing Monaco editor demo; I traced it separately from the logo changes.

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+const BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/promptbook-logo';
+
+async function checkLogoImages(page, minimumCount) {
+    const LOGOS = page.locator('img[src*="promptbook-logo-3d"]');
+    assert.ok((await LOGOS.count()) >= minimumCount, 'Expected shared 3D logo instances');
+    for (const LOGO of await LOGOS.all()) {
+        if (!(await LOGO.isVisible())) continue;
+        await LOGO.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await LOGO.evaluate((image) => image.decode());
+        const DIMENSIONS = await LOGO.evaluate((image) => ({
+            naturalWidth: image.naturalWidth,
+            width: image.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+            height: image.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+            filter: getComputedStyle(image).filter,
+        }));
+        assert.ok(DIMENSIONS.naturalWidth > 0, 'Logo must load');
+        assert.ok(Math.abs(DIMENSIONS.width - DIMENSIONS.height) < 1, 'Logo must remain square');
+        assert.ok(!DIMENSIONS.filter.includes('brightness(0)'), '3D shading must be preserved');
+    }
+}
+
+(async () => {
+    const BROWSER = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 } });
+        await PAGE.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        const ERRORS = [];
+        PAGE.on('pageerror', (error) => {
+            const DETAIL = { url: PAGE.url(), message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
+            ERRORS.push(DETAIL);
+            console.error('Page error:', DETAIL);
+        });
+        for (const ROUTE of ['/cs', '/en', '/branding', '/dekujeme']) {
+            const RESPONSE = await PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}${ROUTE}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+            assert.ok(RESPONSE.ok(), `${ROUTE} must load`);
+            await PAGE.locator('h1').waitFor();
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, ROUTE === '/branding' ? 4 : ROUTE === '/dekujeme' ? 2 : 3);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} desktop overflow`);
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                const DOWNLOAD_PROMISE = PAGE.waitForEvent('download');
+                await PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).click();
+                const DOWNLOAD = await DOWNLOAD_PROMISE;
+                assert.equal(DOWNLOAD.suggestedFilename(), 'promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png');
+                await DOWNLOAD.saveAs(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/downloaded-logo.png`);
+                const COLLECTION = PAGE.locator('section').filter({ has: PAGE.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pick the logo that fits the background.' }) });
+                assert.equal(await COLLECTION.locator('article').count(), 4);
+                for (const LINK of await COLLECTION.locator('a[download]').all()) {
+                    const ASSET_RESPONSE = await PAGE.request.get(new URL(await LINK.getAttribute('href'), BASE_URL).href);
+                    assert.ok(ASSET_RESPONSE.ok(), 'Every brand-kit download must exist');
+                }
+                await COLLECTION.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-downloads.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/footer-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, 2);
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} mobile overflow`);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-mobile.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                await PAGE.getByAltText('Promptbook logo in 3D', { exact: true }).screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-mobile-preview.png` });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('main > section').first().screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/homepage-mobile-hero.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            console.log(`${ROUTE}: desktop/mobile logos, layout and page checked`);
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        }
+        assert.deepEqual(ERRORS, [], 'Pages must have no runtime errors');
+        await PAGE.close();
+
+        const STATIC_PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ javaScriptEnabled: false, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
+        await STATIC_PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}/branding`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        assert.equal(await STATIC_PAGE.locator('img[alt="Promptbook logo in 3D"]').count(), 1);
+        assert.ok(await STATIC_PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).isVisible());
+        console.log('Brand-kit logo and download are server-rendered without JavaScript');
+    } finally {
+        await BROWSER.close();
+    }
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/components/promptbook-logo.tsx b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89408328e3be1e5877b76bbb01a84db3ec7995ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS } from '@/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+interface PromptbookLogoProps {
+    size?: number;
+    alt?: string;
+    className?: string;
+    isPriority?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The shared 3D mark. Use an empty alternative when adjacent text already names the brand.
+ * Next image optimization is disabled here, so choose a local render at twice the display size.
+ */
+export function PromptbookLogo({ size = 32, alt = 'Promptbook', className, isPriority = false }: PromptbookLogoProps) {
+    const LOGO_SOURCE =
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.find(({ width }) => width >= size * 2) ??
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS[PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.length - 1];
+
+    return (
+        <Image
+            src={LOGO_SOURCE.src}
+            alt={alt}
+            width={size}
+            height={size}
+            priority={isPriority}
+            className={cn('shrink-0 object-contain', className)}
+        />
+    );
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b53f41ebf7bea1d0f4a40b84e87c6e992adf4bd1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+/** Transparent download and web-sized renders of the same 3D artwork. */
+export const PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_DOWNLOAD_PATH = '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+
+export const PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS = [
+    { width: 128, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-128.webp' },
+    { width: 256, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-256.webp' },
+    { width: 512, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-512.webp' },
+    { width: 1024, src: '/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.webp' },
+] as const;
diff --git a/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2c00f47272d7e26865fb5a5f92b11c88b72f098f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+# Promptbook 3D logo
+
+This is a static 3D render of `promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-1024.png`, generated
+with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-21. It keeps the three-part PB composition
+and adds blue surfaces, shallow extrusion, bevels and studio lighting. It is a raster
+brand asset, not an editable 3D model.
+
+`promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png` is the transparent, 1024 × 1024 download.
+The 128, 256, 512 and 1024-pixel WebP files are web previews of that same image.
+The shared `PromptbookLogo` component selects a preview at twice the requested display
+size, capped at 1024 pixels, because this site's Next.js image optimization is disabled.
+Small navigation logos therefore load the 128-pixel asset, not the full PNG.
+
+The PNG was resized from the generated image with Sharp, preserving alpha. The WebP
+exports use quality 88 and alpha quality 100. Keep them in step after any artwork change:
+
+```sh
+node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+
+const SOURCE_PATH = 'public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+for (const SIZE of [128, 256, 512, 1024]) {
+    await sharp(SOURCE_PATH)
+        .resize(SIZE, SIZE)
+        .webp({ quality: 88, alphaQuality: 100 })
+        .toFile(`public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-${SIZE}.webp`);
+}
+NODE
+```
+
+The `/branding` page previews the render and offers the PNG next to the existing flat
+variants. The flat files remain suitable for print, small favicons and high-contrast
+uses. Do not apply monochrome CSS filters to the 3D image: they remove its shading.
+The dark footer and participant-room headers give the small blue render a white
+backing so its edges remain visible in either room appearance.
+
+## Generation prompt
+
+The existing blue transparent PNG was supplied as the edit target.
+
+```text
+Use case: style-transfer.
+Asset type: official Promptbook 3D logo render for a website header, footer and large brand-kit preview, square transparent PNG.
+Input image: the supplied Promptbook logo is the edit target and exact silhouette reference.
+Primary request: convert this precise flat blue mark into a beautifully lit three-dimensional solid with shallow visible extrusion and refined bevels. Preserve the original three separate shapes and their exact positions, proportions, camera angle and negative spaces: the floating triangle above, the P-shaped left face, and the large right face with its open B-shaped cutout. Preserve the recognizable PB cube/book composition. The front silhouette must match the reference; add depth behind it, not a redesigned cube.
+Style/materials: premium product rendering of deep royal-blue satin anodized metal or enamel, fine rounded edge bevels, smooth broad faces, convincing darker blue side walls and cool pale-blue edge reflections. No gritty texture. Keep the blue rich, close to the reference, with enough bright edge light to read on both white and very dark backgrounds.
+Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left, delicate cool rim light; restrained ambient occlusion only on the object. No floor, no cast shadow outside the object.
+Composition: one centered logo, fills about 88 percent of the square canvas, whole object visible with clear margins. The triangle and both letter faces must remain distinct and separated exactly as in the reference. Transparent background with actual alpha, including all gaps and cutouts.
+Constraints: change only depth, surface and lighting. Do not add letters, text, words, other shapes, a pedestal, an enclosing cube, a background, a gradient backdrop, glow, blur, watermark or checkerboard pixels. Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background.
+```

diff --git a/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b9854103095be2069a7cc2f44fdfb7ba04701bc8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+const BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/promptbook-logo';
+
+async function checkLogoImages(page, minimumCount) {
+    const LOGOS = page.locator('img[src*="promptbook-logo-3d"]');
+    assert.ok((await LOGOS.count()) >= minimumCount, 'Expected shared 3D logo instances');
+    for (const LOGO of await LOGOS.all()) {
+        if (!(await LOGO.isVisible())) continue;
+        await LOGO.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await LOGO.evaluate((image) => image.decode());
+        const DIMENSIONS = await LOGO.evaluate((image) => ({
+            naturalWidth: image.naturalWidth,
+            width: image.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+            height: image.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+            filter: getComputedStyle(image).filter,
+        }));
+        assert.ok(DIMENSIONS.naturalWidth > 0, 'Logo must load');
+        assert.ok(Math.abs(DIMENSIONS.width - DIMENSIONS.height) < 1, 'Logo must remain square');
+        assert.ok(!DIMENSIONS.filter.includes('brightness(0)'), '3D shading must be preserved');
+    }
+}
+
+(async () => {
+    const BROWSER = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 } });
+        await PAGE.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        const ERRORS = [];
+        PAGE.on('pageerror', (error) => {
+            const DETAIL = { url: PAGE.url(), message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
+            ERRORS.push(DETAIL);
+            console.error('Page error:', DETAIL);
+        });
+        for (const ROUTE of ['/cs', '/en', '/branding', '/dekujeme']) {
+            const RESPONSE = await PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}${ROUTE}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+            assert.ok(RESPONSE.ok(), `${ROUTE} must load`);
+            await PAGE.locator('h1').waitFor();
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, ROUTE === '/branding' ? 4 : ROUTE === '/dekujeme' ? 2 : 3);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} desktop overflow`);
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                const DOWNLOAD_PROMISE = PAGE.waitForEvent('download');
+                await PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).click();
+                const DOWNLOAD = await DOWNLOAD_PROMISE;
+                assert.equal(DOWNLOAD.suggestedFilename(), 'promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png');
+                await DOWNLOAD.saveAs(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/downloaded-logo.png`);
+                const COLLECTION = PAGE.locator('section').filter({ has: PAGE.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pick the logo that fits the background.' }) });
+                assert.equal(await COLLECTION.locator('article').count(), 4);
+                for (const LINK of await COLLECTION.locator('a[download]').all()) {
+                    const ASSET_RESPONSE = await PAGE.request.get(new URL(await LINK.getAttribute('href'), BASE_URL).href);
+                    assert.ok(ASSET_RESPONSE.ok(), 'Every brand-kit download must exist');
+                }
+                await COLLECTION.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-downloads.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/footer-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, 2);
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} mobile overflow`);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-mobile.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                await PAGE.getByAltText('Promptbook logo in 3D', { exact: true }).screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-mobile-preview.png` });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('main > section').first().screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/homepage-mobile-hero.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            console.log(`${ROUTE}: desktop/mobile logos, layout and page checked`);
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        }
+        assert.deepEqual(ERRORS, [], 'Pages must have no runtime errors');
+        await PAGE.close();
+
+        const STATIC_PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ javaScriptEnabled: false, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
+        await STATIC_PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}/branding`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        assert.equal(await STATIC_PAGE.locator('img[alt="Promptbook logo in 3D"]').count(), 1);
+        assert.ok(await STATIC_PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).isVisible());
+        console.log('Brand-kit logo and download are server-rendered without JavaScript');
+    } finally {
+        await BROWSER.close();
+    }
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89408328e3be1e5877b76bbb01a84db3ec7995ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS } from '@/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+interface PromptbookLogoProps {
+    size?: number;
+    alt?: string;
+    className?: string;
+    isPriority?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The shared 3D mark. Use an empty alternative when adjacent text already names the brand.
+ * Next image optimization is disabled here, so choose a local render at twice the display size.
+ */
+export function PromptbookLogo({ size = 32, alt = 'Promptbook', className, isPriority = false }: PromptbookLogoProps) {
+    const LOGO_SOURCE =
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.find(({ width }) => width >= size * 2) ??
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS[PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.length - 1];
+
+    return (
+        <Image
+            src={LOGO_SOURCE.src}
+            alt={alt}
+            width={size}
+            height={size}
+            priority={isPriority}
+            className={cn('shrink-0 object-contain', className)}
+        />
+    );
+}

diff --git a/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2c00f47272d7e26865fb5a5f92b11c88b72f098f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+# Promptbook 3D logo
+
+This is a static 3D render of `promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-1024.png`, generated
+with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-21. It keeps the three-part PB composition
+and adds blue surfaces, shallow extrusion, bevels and studio lighting. It is a raster
+brand asset, not an editable 3D model.
+
+`promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png` is the transparent, 1024 × 1024 download.
+The 128, 256, 512 and 1024-pixel WebP files are web previews of that same image.
+The shared `PromptbookLogo` component selects a preview at twice the requested display
+size, capped at 1024 pixels, because this site's Next.js image optimization is disabled.
+Small navigation logos therefore load the 128-pixel asset, not the full PNG.
+
+The PNG was resized from the generated image with Sharp, preserving alpha. The WebP
+exports use quality 88 and alpha quality 100. Keep them in step after any artwork change:
+
+```sh
+node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+
+const SOURCE_PATH = 'public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+for (const SIZE of [128, 256, 512, 1024]) {
+    await sharp(SOURCE_PATH)
+        .resize(SIZE, SIZE)
+        .webp({ quality: 88, alphaQuality: 100 })
+        .toFile(`public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-${SIZE}.webp`);
+}
+NODE
+```
+
+The `/branding` page previews the render and offers the PNG next to the existing flat
+variants. The flat files remain suitable for print, small favicons and high-contrast
+uses. Do not apply monochrome CSS filters to the 3D image: they remove its shading.
+The dark footer and participant-room headers give the small blue render a white
+backing so its edges remain visible in either room appearance.
+
+## Generation prompt
+
+The existing blue transparent PNG was supplied as the edit target.
+
+```text
+Use case: style-transfer.
+Asset type: official Promptbook 3D logo render for a website header, footer and large brand-kit preview, square transparent PNG.
+Input image: the supplied Promptbook logo is the edit target and exact silhouette reference.
+Primary request: convert this precise flat blue mark into a beautifully lit three-dimensional solid with shallow visible extrusion and refined bevels. Preserve the original three separate shapes and their exact positions, proportions, camera angle and negative spaces: the floating triangle above, the P-shaped left face, and the large right face with its open B-shaped cutout. Preserve the recognizable PB cube/book composition. The front silhouette must match the reference; add depth behind it, not a redesigned cube.
+Style/materials: premium product rendering of deep royal-blue satin anodized metal or enamel, fine rounded edge bevels, smooth broad faces, convincing darker blue side walls and cool pale-blue edge reflections. No gritty texture. Keep the blue rich, close to the reference, with enough bright edge light to read on both white and very dark backgrounds.
+Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left, delicate cool rim light; restrained ambient occlusion only on the object. No floor, no cast shadow outside the object.
+Composition: one centered logo, fills about 88 percent of the square canvas, whole object visible with clear margins. The triangle and both letter faces must remain distinct and separated exactly as in the reference. Transparent background with actual alpha, including all gaps and cutouts.
+Constraints: change only depth, surface and lighting. Do not add letters, text, words, other shapes, a pedestal, an enclosing cube, a background, a gradient backdrop, glow, blur, watermark or checkerboard pixels. Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background.
+```

diff --git a/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b9854103095be2069a7cc2f44fdfb7ba04701bc8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+const BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/promptbook-logo';
+
+async function checkLogoImages(page, minimumCount) {
+    const LOGOS = page.locator('img[src*="promptbook-logo-3d"]');
+    assert.ok((await LOGOS.count()) >= minimumCount, 'Expected shared 3D logo instances');
+    for (const LOGO of await LOGOS.all()) {
+        if (!(await LOGO.isVisible())) continue;
+        await LOGO.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await LOGO.evaluate((image) => image.decode());
+        const DIMENSIONS = await LOGO.evaluate((image) => ({
+            naturalWidth: image.naturalWidth,
+            width: image.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+            height: image.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+            filter: getComputedStyle(image).filter,
+        }));
+        assert.ok(DIMENSIONS.naturalWidth > 0, 'Logo must load');
+        assert.ok(Math.abs(DIMENSIONS.width - DIMENSIONS.height) < 1, 'Logo must remain square');
+        assert.ok(!DIMENSIONS.filter.includes('brightness(0)'), '3D shading must be preserved');
+    }
+}
+
+(async () => {
+    const BROWSER = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 } });
+        await PAGE.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        const ERRORS = [];
+        PAGE.on('pageerror', (error) => {
+            const DETAIL = { url: PAGE.url(), message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
+            ERRORS.push(DETAIL);
+            console.error('Page error:', DETAIL);
+        });
+        for (const ROUTE of ['/cs', '/en', '/branding', '/dekujeme']) {
+            const RESPONSE = await PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}${ROUTE}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+            assert.ok(RESPONSE.ok(), `${ROUTE} must load`);
+            await PAGE.locator('h1').waitFor();
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, ROUTE === '/branding' ? 4 : ROUTE === '/dekujeme' ? 2 : 3);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} desktop overflow`);
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                const DOWNLOAD_PROMISE = PAGE.waitForEvent('download');
+                await PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).click();
+                const DOWNLOAD = await DOWNLOAD_PROMISE;
+                assert.equal(DOWNLOAD.suggestedFilename(), 'promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png');
+                await DOWNLOAD.saveAs(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/downloaded-logo.png`);
+                const COLLECTION = PAGE.locator('section').filter({ has: PAGE.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pick the logo that fits the background.' }) });
+                assert.equal(await COLLECTION.locator('article').count(), 4);
+                for (const LINK of await COLLECTION.locator('a[download]').all()) {
+                    const ASSET_RESPONSE = await PAGE.request.get(new URL(await LINK.getAttribute('href'), BASE_URL).href);
+                    assert.ok(ASSET_RESPONSE.ok(), 'Every brand-kit download must exist');
+                }
+                await COLLECTION.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-downloads.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/footer-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, 2);
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} mobile overflow`);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-mobile.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                await PAGE.getByAltText('Promptbook logo in 3D', { exact: true }).screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-mobile-preview.png` });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('main > section').first().screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/homepage-mobile-hero.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            console.log(`${ROUTE}: desktop/mobile logos, layout and page checked`);
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        }
+        assert.deepEqual(ERRORS, [], 'Pages must have no runtime errors');
+        await PAGE.close();
+
+        const STATIC_PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ javaScriptEnabled: false, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
+        await STATIC_PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}/branding`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        assert.equal(await STATIC_PAGE.locator('img[alt="Promptbook logo in 3D"]').count(), 1);
+        assert.ok(await STATIC_PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).isVisible());
+        console.log('Brand-kit logo and download are server-rendered without JavaScript');
+    } finally {
+        await BROWSER.close();
+    }
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89408328e3be1e5877b76bbb01a84db3ec7995ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS } from '@/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+interface PromptbookLogoProps {
+    size?: number;
+    alt?: string;
+    className?: string;
+    isPriority?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The shared 3D mark. Use an empty alternative when adjacent text already names the brand.
+ * Next image optimization is disabled here, so choose a local render at twice the display size.
+ */
+export function PromptbookLogo({ size = 32, alt = 'Promptbook', className, isPriority = false }: PromptbookLogoProps) {
+    const LOGO_SOURCE =
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.find(({ width }) => width >= size * 2) ??
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS[PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.length - 1];
+
+    return (
+        <Image
+            src={LOGO_SOURCE.src}
+            alt={alt}
+            width={size}
+            height={size}
+            priority={isPriority}
+            className={cn('shrink-0 object-contain', className)}
+        />
+    );
+}

diff --git a/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2c00f47272d7e26865fb5a5f92b11c88b72f098f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+# Promptbook 3D logo
+
+This is a static 3D render of `promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-1024.png`, generated
+with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-21. It keeps the three-part PB composition
+and adds blue surfaces, shallow extrusion, bevels and studio lighting. It is a raster
+brand asset, not an editable 3D model.
+
+`promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png` is the transparent, 1024 × 1024 download.
+The 128, 256, 512 and 1024-pixel WebP files are web previews of that same image.
+The shared `PromptbookLogo` component selects a preview at twice the requested display
+size, capped at 1024 pixels, because this site's Next.js image optimization is disabled.
+Small navigation logos therefore load the 128-pixel asset, not the full PNG.
+
+The PNG was resized from the generated image with Sharp, preserving alpha. The WebP
+exports use quality 88 and alpha quality 100. Keep them in step after any artwork change:
+
+```sh
+node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+
+const SOURCE_PATH = 'public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+for (const SIZE of [128, 256, 512, 1024]) {
+    await sharp(SOURCE_PATH)
+        .resize(SIZE, SIZE)
+        .webp({ quality: 88, alphaQuality: 100 })
+        .toFile(`public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-${SIZE}.webp`);
+}
+NODE
+```
+
+The `/branding` page previews the render and offers the PNG next to the existing flat
+variants. The flat files remain suitable for print, small favicons and high-contrast
+uses. Do not apply monochrome CSS filters to the 3D image: they remove its shading.
+The dark footer and participant-room headers give the small blue render a white
+backing so its edges remain visible in either room appearance.
+
+## Generation prompt
+
+The existing blue transparent PNG was supplied as the edit target.
+
+```text
+Use case: style-transfer.
+Asset type: official Promptbook 3D logo render for a website header, footer and large brand-kit preview, square transparent PNG.
+Input image: the supplied Promptbook logo is the edit target and exact silhouette reference.
+Primary request: convert this precise flat blue mark into a beautifully lit three-dimensional solid with shallow visible extrusion and refined bevels. Preserve the original three separate shapes and their exact positions, proportions, camera angle and negative spaces: the floating triangle above, the P-shaped left face, and the large right face with its open B-shaped cutout. Preserve the recognizable PB cube/book composition. The front silhouette must match the reference; add depth behind it, not a redesigned cube.
+Style/materials: premium product rendering of deep royal-blue satin anodized metal or enamel, fine rounded edge bevels, smooth broad faces, convincing darker blue side walls and cool pale-blue edge reflections. No gritty texture. Keep the blue rich, close to the reference, with enough bright edge light to read on both white and very dark backgrounds.
+Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left, delicate cool rim light; restrained ambient occlusion only on the object. No floor, no cast shadow outside the object.
+Composition: one centered logo, fills about 88 percent of the square canvas, whole object visible with clear margins. The triangle and both letter faces must remain distinct and separated exactly as in the reference. Transparent background with actual alpha, including all gaps and cutouts.
+Constraints: change only depth, surface and lighting. Do not add letters, text, words, other shapes, a pedestal, an enclosing cube, a background, a gradient backdrop, glow, blur, watermark or checkerboard pixels. Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background.
+```

codex
Created the 3D-rendered logo and integrated it into shared headers, footers, homepage chat, participant rooms, and `/branding`.

[Download PNG](/Users/hejny/work/aldaron/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png) · [Built-in imagegen prompt and asset notes](/Users/hejny/work/aldaron/public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d.md)

Verified build, TypeScript, 30 unit tests, five browser tests, downloads, and mobile layouts. Existing lint and editor-demo cancellation warnings remain.
diff --git a/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b9854103095be2069a7cc2f44fdfb7ba04701bc8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/promptbook-logo/check-layout.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+const BASE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009';
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/promptbook-logo';
+
+async function checkLogoImages(page, minimumCount) {
+    const LOGOS = page.locator('img[src*="promptbook-logo-3d"]');
+    assert.ok((await LOGOS.count()) >= minimumCount, 'Expected shared 3D logo instances');
+    for (const LOGO of await LOGOS.all()) {
+        if (!(await LOGO.isVisible())) continue;
+        await LOGO.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await LOGO.evaluate((image) => image.decode());
+        const DIMENSIONS = await LOGO.evaluate((image) => ({
+            naturalWidth: image.naturalWidth,
+            width: image.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+            height: image.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+            filter: getComputedStyle(image).filter,
+        }));
+        assert.ok(DIMENSIONS.naturalWidth > 0, 'Logo must load');
+        assert.ok(Math.abs(DIMENSIONS.width - DIMENSIONS.height) < 1, 'Logo must remain square');
+        assert.ok(!DIMENSIONS.filter.includes('brightness(0)'), '3D shading must be preserved');
+    }
+}
+
+(async () => {
+    const BROWSER = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 } });
+        await PAGE.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        const ERRORS = [];
+        PAGE.on('pageerror', (error) => {
+            const DETAIL = { url: PAGE.url(), message: error.message, stack: error.stack };
+            ERRORS.push(DETAIL);
+            console.error('Page error:', DETAIL);
+        });
+        for (const ROUTE of ['/cs', '/en', '/branding', '/dekujeme']) {
+            const RESPONSE = await PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}${ROUTE}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+            assert.ok(RESPONSE.ok(), `${ROUTE} must load`);
+            await PAGE.locator('h1').waitFor();
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, ROUTE === '/branding' ? 4 : ROUTE === '/dekujeme' ? 2 : 3);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} desktop overflow`);
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                const DOWNLOAD_PROMISE = PAGE.waitForEvent('download');
+                await PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).click();
+                const DOWNLOAD = await DOWNLOAD_PROMISE;
+                assert.equal(DOWNLOAD.suggestedFilename(), 'promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png');
+                await DOWNLOAD.saveAs(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/downloaded-logo.png`);
+                const COLLECTION = PAGE.locator('section').filter({ has: PAGE.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pick the logo that fits the background.' }) });
+                assert.equal(await COLLECTION.locator('article').count(), 4);
+                for (const LINK of await COLLECTION.locator('a[download]').all()) {
+                    const ASSET_RESPONSE = await PAGE.request.get(new URL(await LINK.getAttribute('href'), BASE_URL).href);
+                    assert.ok(ASSET_RESPONSE.ok(), 'Every brand-kit download must exist');
+                }
+                await COLLECTION.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-downloads.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('footer').screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/footer-desktop.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+            await checkLogoImages(PAGE, 2);
+            assert.ok(await PAGE.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `${ROUTE} mobile overflow`);
+            await PAGE.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
+            await PAGE.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${ROUTE.slice(1)}-mobile.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            if (ROUTE === '/branding') {
+                await PAGE.getByAltText('Promptbook logo in 3D', { exact: true }).screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/branding-mobile-preview.png` });
+            }
+            if (ROUTE === '/cs') {
+                await PAGE.locator('main > section').first().screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/homepage-mobile-hero.png`, animations: 'disabled' });
+            }
+            console.log(`${ROUTE}: desktop/mobile logos, layout and page checked`);
+            await PAGE.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        }
+        assert.deepEqual(ERRORS, [], 'Pages must have no runtime errors');
+        await PAGE.close();
+
+        const STATIC_PAGE = await BROWSER.newPage({ javaScriptEnabled: false, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
+        await STATIC_PAGE.goto(`${BASE_URL}/branding`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        assert.equal(await STATIC_PAGE.locator('img[alt="Promptbook logo in 3D"]').count(), 1);
+        assert.ok(await STATIC_PAGE.getByRole('link', { name: 'Download the 3D logo', exact: true }).isVisible());
+        console.log('Brand-kit logo and download are server-rendered without JavaScript');
+    } finally {
+        await BROWSER.close();
+    }
+})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/components/promptbook-logo.tsx b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89408328e3be1e5877b76bbb01a84db3ec7995ec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/components/promptbook-logo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS } from '@/lib/branding/promptbookLogoAssets';
+import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
+import Image from 'next/image';
+
+interface PromptbookLogoProps {
+    size?: number;
+    alt?: string;
+    className?: string;
+    isPriority?: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The shared 3D mark. Use an empty alternative when adjacent text already names the brand.
+ * Next image optimization is disabled here, so choose a local render at twice the display size.
+ */
+export function PromptbookLogo({ size = 32, alt = 'Promptbook', className, isPriority = false }: PromptbookLogoProps) {
+    const LOGO_SOURCE =
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.find(({ width }) => width >= size * 2) ??
+        PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS[PROMPTBOOK_LOGO_3D_PREVIEWS.length - 1];
+
+    return (
+        <Image
+            src={LOGO_SOURCE.src}
+            alt={alt}
+            width={size}
+            height={size}
+            priority={isPriority}
+            className={cn('shrink-0 object-contain', className)}
+        />
+    );
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+# Promptbook 3D logo
+
+This is a static 3D render of `promptbook-logo-blue-transparent-1024.png`, generated
+with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-09-21. It keeps the three-part PB composition
+and adds blue surfaces, shallow extrusion, bevels and studio lighting. It is a raster
+brand asset, not an editable 3D model.
+
+`promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png` is the transparent, 1024 × 1024 download.
+The 128, 256, 512 and 1024-pixel WebP files are web previews of that same image.
+The shared `PromptbookLogo` component selects a preview at twice the requested display
+size, capped at 1024 pixels, because this site's Next.js image optimization is disabled.
+Small navigation logos therefore load the 128-pixel asset, not the full PNG.
+
+The PNG was resized from the generated image with Sharp, preserving alpha. The WebP
+exports use quality 88 and alpha quality 100. Keep them in step after any artwork change:
+
+```sh
+node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+
+const SOURCE_PATH = 'public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-1024.png';
+for (const SIZE of [128, 256, 512, 1024]) {
+    await sharp(SOURCE_PATH)
+        .resize(SIZE, SIZE)
+        .webp({ quality: 88, alphaQuality: 100 })
+        .toFile(`public/logo/promptbook-logo-3d-transparent-${SIZE}.webp`);
+}
+NODE
+```
+
+The `/branding` page previews the render and offers the PNG next to the existing flat
+variants. The flat files remain suitable for print, small favicons and high-contrast
+uses. Do not apply monochrome CSS filters to the 3D image: they remove its shading.
+The dark footer and participant-room headers give the small blue render a white
+backing so its edges remain visible in either room appearance.
+
+## Generation prompt
+
+The existing blue transparent PNG was supplied as the edit target.
+
+```text
+Use case: style-transfer.
+Asset type: official Promptbook 3D logo render for a website header, footer and large brand-kit preview, square transparent PNG.
+Input image: the supplied Promptbook logo is the edit target and exact silhouette reference.
+Primary request: convert this precise flat blue mark into a beautifully lit three-dimensional solid with shallow visible extrusion and refined bevels. Preserve the original three separate shapes and their exact positions, proportions, camera angle and negative spaces: the floating triangle above, the P-shaped left face, and the large right face with its open B-shaped cutout. Preserve the recognizable PB cube/book composition. The front silhouette must match the reference; add depth behind it, not a redesigned cube.
+Style/materials: premium product rendering of deep royal-blue satin anodized metal or enamel, fine rounded edge bevels, smooth broad faces, convincing darker blue side walls and cool pale-blue edge reflections. No gritty texture. Keep the blue rich, close to the reference, with enough bright edge light to read on both white and very dark backgrounds.
+Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left, delicate cool rim light; restrained ambient occlusion only on the object. No floor, no cast shadow outside the object.
+Composition: one centered logo, fills about 88 percent of the square canvas, whole object visible with clear margins. The triangle and both letter faces must remain distinct and separated exactly as in the reference. Transparent background with actual alpha, including all gaps and cutouts.
+Constraints: change only depth, surface and lighting. Do not add letters, text, words, other shapes, a pedestal, an enclosing cube, a background, a gradient backdrop, glow, blur, watermark or checkerboard pixels. Output one 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background.
+```
